  "scheduler_affects_equiv aag l s s' \<equiv>
     (states_equiv_for_labels aag (\<lambda>l'. l' \<in> reads_scheduler aag l) s s' \<and>
      (reads_scheduler_cur_domain aag l s \<or> reads_scheduler_cur_domain aag l s'
       \<longrightarrow> (cur_thread s = cur_thread s' \<and> scheduler_action s = scheduler_action s' \<and>
            work_units_completed s = work_units_completed s' \<and>
            scheduler_globals_frame_equiv s s' \<and> idle_thread s = idle_thread s' \<and>
            (cur_thread s \<noteq> idle_thread s' \<longrightarrow> arch_scheduler_affects_equiv s s'))))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation reads_respects_scheduler where

 1. \<lbrace>(\<lambda>s. domain_time s \<noteq> 0) and (\<lambda>s. Q (cur_domain s))\<rbrace> do ct <- gets cur_thread;

ct_runnable <- return $ runnable ct_st;
action <- gets scheduler_action;
case action of resume_cur_thread \<Rightarrow> do id <- gets idle_thread;
assert (ct_runnable \<or> ct = id);
return ()
od | switch_thread candidate \<Rightarrow> do when ct_runnable (tcb_sched_action tcb_sched_enqueue ct);
it <- gets idle_thread;
target_prio <- ethread_get tcb_priority candidate;
ct_prio <- ethread_get_when (ct \<noteq> it) tcb_priority ct;
fastfail <- schedule_switch_thread_fastfail ct it ct_prio target_prio;
cur_dom <- gets cur_domain;
highest <- gets (is_highest_prio cur_dom target_prio);
if fastfail \<and> \<not> highest then do tcb_sched_action tcb_sched_enqueue candidate;
set_scheduler_action choose_new_thread;
schedule_choose_new_thread
od else if ct_runnable \<and> ct_prio = target_prio then do tcb_sched_action tcb_sched_append candidate;
set_scheduler_action choose_new_thread;
schedule_choose_new_thread
od else do guarded_switch_to candidate;
set_scheduler_action resume_cur_thread
od
od | choose_new_thread \<Rightarrow> do when ct_runnable (tcb_sched_action tcb_sched_enqueue ct);
